Who I Am

I didn't come from a system
that was built for me.
So I built one.

Over the last several years, I've dedicated my work to one idea. People don't need permission to participate in the new digital economy. They need access, education, and an ecosystem that takes them seriously.

The Community · Live Event

That's what I build. Through Rebirth Odyssey and my broader ecosystem, I've onboarded tens of thousands of people into Web3. Not just as users, but as earners, builders, and long-term participants. The numbers are real. The people are real. The movement is real.

I operate at the intersection of ecosystem growth, digital finance, creator culture, and strategic infrastructure, partnering with global protocols, exchanges, and projects to drive real traction in one of the world's fastest-growing digital markets.

This is not a portfolio. This is a headquarters.

What I Do

01

Ecosystem Building

I design and operate communities that don't just grow. They produce. From university penetration to protocol-level partnerships, I build infrastructure that creates long-term value for every participant inside it.

02

Web3 Education

I've trained over 22,000 people across Africa. Not surface-level content. Real onboarding into wallets, DeFi, trading, NFTs, and digital opportunity. Education that changes economic trajectories.

03

Strategic Partnerships

I connect projects with markets they can't reach alone. I've driven millions in ecosystem visibility, trading activity, and community engagement for exchanges, wallets, and infrastructure protocols across the space.

04

Speaking & Representation

I bring ecosystem depth, cultural context, and clear strategic thinking to stages across Africa and beyond. I've spoken at and represented projects at some of the continent's most significant blockchain events.

Not a community group. A structured onboarding ecosystem.

Rebirth Odyssey is built specifically to take people with zero Web3 knowledge and turn them into active, earning participants. Every element (the curriculum, the community structure, the partnership layer) is designed for long-term impact, not hype.

  • 16,000+ students onboarded into Web3 with real skill acquisition
  • Deep penetration across universities across Africa
  • Community members collectively earning $2,000,000+ through Web3
  • Active partnerships with major exchanges, wallets, and protocols
  • Structured curriculum from wallets to DeFi to ecosystem participation
